run_note: Run covering 2026-08-11 -> 2026-08-12, executed 08:03 UTC Wednesday, US pre-market (04:03 ET). NO R1 BREACH and NO SIM-INTEGRITY ALERT: the only two new fills are hunter's SLV->PLTR rotation, both first appearing in commit 31f81b9 at 2026-08-11T13:34:32Z = 09:34:32 ET Tuesday, inside US regular hours, at prices inside the day's range (SLV 58.50 in 58.16-58.99; PLTR 174.8786 in 172.72-177.94). THE HEADLINE IS THAT LAST REVIEW'S REBASE-CONFLICT DIAGNOSIS IS NOW PROVEN, NOT INFERRED. Run 31548925913's log shows the exact mechanism: at 2026-08-12T01:34:24Z the loop's rebase hit CONFLICT (content) across every dashboard file, could not apply commit 7ee1c8c, and all three push retries died on 'Pulling is not possible because you have unmerged files'. The unmerged working tree poisoned data/*.json, and from 01:47:50Z every one of the nine trading bots raised JSONDecodeError on its own state file - 225 crashes across 25 consecutive cycles until 07:14:59Z, ending only when a fresh checkout at 07:29Z reset the tree. THE FLEET WAS DEAD FOR 5H42M AND THE RUN'S CONCLUSION IS 'success': each crash is swallowed as a ##[warning], the exit code stays 0, and the dashboards simply stop advancing. Green checkmarks, dead fleet. Cost this time was limited because the window was overnight ET - no equity fill was possible - but crypto trades 24/7 and ran 5h42m of live tape with no exit and no stop. IMPORTANT CORRECTION TO LAST REVIEW: not every ~6h gap is this bug. The 2026-08-11 13:34Z->19:43Z window was the DOCUMENTED architectural hole - run 31459784322 ran 07:58:13Z to 13:47:34Z, a clean 349-minute loop-cap exit with one isolated cycle failure - so the fleet has two independent ~6h failure modes that produce identical-looking gaps, and only one of them is a bug. Real uptime remains near 50% of wall-clock either way. THE GROK WATCHER IS STILL DARK, now 118 hours, confirmed cause 'xAI HTTP 403: your team has either used all available credits or reached its monthly spending limit' - NOT the monthly cap, which sits at 15 of 100. Two consequences are now concrete rather than theoretical: the hype bot's exit rule is structurally unfirable and it has held NET five days on a 1-2 day strategy, and the Analyst's 'auto-exit on Watcher SEVERE' is a dead switch it re-cites as live in every decision. NEW THIS RUN: congress published a wrong day P/L - it marked NVDA and TSM at 08-11 closes but META and GOOG at 08-10 closes, and GOOG fell 3.38%, so its reported +0.88 was really about -2.49. Not a SIM-INTEGRITY ALERT (no trade occurred) but its dashboard is overstated by about $3.35, and it is the only bot of nine whose mark fails to reconcile. Reported only, nothing touched.

If it loses, the lesson is that I dressed a price view in mechanism language, and I have written that test down in advance so I cannot rewrite it afterwards.
